Hi Elena —

Thanks for sending the invoice and the redacted bank statement. A few quick items our AP team needs to clear payment: 

1) Completed tax form from Redwood: we will attach a signed W-9 (PDF).
2) Vendor legal name confirmation (to match W-9): "Redwood Inference, Inc."
3) Remit contact and billing email to send payment confirmation (we use ACH/Wire).
4) For international remittances we also need the beneficiary bank SWIFT and country (if wiring).

We generally do not accept a foreign W-8 from the payee side as a substitute for Redwood's W-9; Redwood must supply a W-9 when the payee is a US person. Attached: Redwood_W9_signed.pdf (signed W-9).

If NovaMed prefers a DocuSign flow, send the envelope link and I'll sign through that channel. Once KYC items above are in place we can request release of funds from our custody partner.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
